title: Storage-owned artifact mutation primitive
description:
Add narrowly scoped `JsonFileStorage` filesystem primitives for physical containment checks, caller-mapped adjacent staging, SHA-256 plus byte-size verification, atomic no-replace publication, and directory-handle-anchored source quarantine/remove/restore. Hidden staging and quarantine locations are owner-private, adjacent to destination/source, unique to operation instance and canonical-path hash, absent and component/symlink-safe before use. The primitive does not plan, lock the whole operation, append events, save issues, relink references, recapture expected identity, derive deletion authority, or orchestrate rollback. Tempdir-backed `JsonFileStorage` tests cover filesystem behavior. Amend `.jit/invariants.toml` and its rendered AGENTS.md projection so `atomic-writes` explicitly covers staged atomic no-replace publication.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Atomic no-replace publish rejects any occupied destination and preserves its bytes; the registry-first `atomic-writes` invariant and rendered projection explicitly cover staged no-replace publication as well as temp-file plus atomic-rename replacement.
- [hard] REQ-02: The API exposes only physical containment, exact-mapping stage, atomic no-replace publish, quarantine/remove, and no-replace restore; publish reports success only when that call created the destination, and collision—including identical bytes—returns `AlreadyExists`; the primitive performs no planning, issue/event mutation, operation guard, identity recapture, authority decision, or rollback orchestration.
- [hard] REQ-03: A race-focused test proves an external writer occupying the destination between planning and finalization causes failure without overwriting the foreign file.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every removal uses the caller-supplied adjacent same-filesystem quarantine mapping and Started SHA-256 plus byte-size: rename source into quarantine, open and verify relative to the directory handle, `unlinkat` only on match, otherwise no-replace restore or preserve/report; no direct unlink or cross-device fallback exists, unsupported platforms return `quarantine-unavailable`, recovery checks both source and recorded entry, and failure injection proves modified pre-existing and receipted destinations retain source.
- [hard] REQ-05: Staging/quarantine directories and entries are hidden, owner-private, adjacent, absent and symlink/component-safe before use; cleanup removes only a verified recorded entry and an empty recorded directory, never nonempty or unverified content.
